answer_1.quote: In this work, we fill in this research gap by proposing a task of Neutral multi-news Summarization (NEUS), which aims to generate a framing-bias-free summary from news articles with varying degrees and orientation of political bias.

answer_2.quote: We use three metrics to evaluate summaries from different dimensions. For framing bias, we propose a polarity-based metric... For evaluating whether the summaries retain salient information, we adopt commonly used information recall metrics... we use a hallucination metric...

answer_4.quote: We conduct A/B testing where the annotators are given two generated articles about an issue... Then, annotators are asked to select the more biased article summary.
answer_4.guideline: Which one of the articles do you believe to be more biased toward one side or the other side in the reporting of news?
